# `cbo_eval_baseline_changes`

**CBO baseline revision changes**

Legislative, economic, and technical revisions recorded between CBO baseline releases.

**Coverage.** True range. Complete US-CBO/eval-projections input_data/baseline_changes.csv spanning 1983-2026 revision dates across Legislative, Economic, and Technical categories for outlays, deficits, and revenues (only Legislative changes are published for revenues). *(measured 2026-11-27)*

- **Parquet file:** `cbo_eval_baseline_changes.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `component` | `VARCHAR` | Budget component (outlay, revenue, or deficit). |
| `category` | `VARCHAR` | Major budget category or Total. |
| `subcategory` | `VARCHAR` | Budget subcategory or Total. |
| `changes_baseline_date` | `DATE` | Year and month of the baseline revision report (day fixed to 01 per CBO convention). |
| `change_category` | `VARCHAR` | Revision classification (Legislative, Economic, or Technical). |
| `projected_fiscal_year` | `BIGINT` | Target federal fiscal year affected by the revision. |
| `change_value_billions` | `DOUBLE` | Dollar revision in billions of dollars; null when blank in the source CSV. |
| `source_commit` | `VARCHAR` | Pinned 40-character Git commit SHA of US-CBO/eval-projections. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Immutable raw GitHub URL for input_data/baseline_changes.csv at source_commit. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 digest of input_data/baseline_changes.csv bytes. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | UTC capture timestamp with timezone. |
